summary: KPI grid for email campaign metrics, composed with KpiCard.
whenToUse: Summarizing opens, clicks, and results of a campaign.
whenNotToUse: Building KPIs from scratch: use KpiCard directly.
accessibility: Reuses KpiCard, which expresses trends and values as text.
responsive: The grid adapts to the number and width of the KPIs.
commonMistakes: Using a metric as the only visual information without a label.
limits: Does not collect or update the metrics.
